'''Memento Square''' is an area  of {{Location|Gorges of Spirits}}. 

It consists of a large, unfinished memorial to the [[Sentinel]] of [[Jinzhou]], [[Jué]]. 

==Features==
One of the [[Torn Pages of Gorges of Spirits]] is located here, on the scaffolding below the statue of the Sentinel.
